newsitem.title: USA: Ford hits regulatory snag on Budget deal - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ford hits regulatory snag on Budget deal - WSJ.

text.p: Speculation is rising that Ford Motor Co may sell the preferred shares it already owns in Budget Rent A Car Corp, due to the attention Ford is getting from federal antitrust regulators over its plan to buy all of the company, The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.

Ford owns Hertz Corp, the largest car rental company. Federal Trade Commission officials apparently believe that buying the number three ranked Budget would give the combined company too much market power, the story says.
It isn't clear whether the FTC opposes the proposed deal outright or has sought changes in its terms, the story says.
